protocol.name: kriss_snap_v1

description.summary: snap layouts for the KrissOS Shell

protocol.description: Lets the shell put a window into a snap zone (a layout's half, third or quarter) and tells it when the pointer rests on a window's maximize button, so it can offer the layouts there. Windows are named by their ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 identifier.

request.name: snap

description.summary: tile a window into a zone of its screen

request.description: The zone is in twelfths of the screen's work area (without panels), so 0 0 6 12 is the left half and 4 0 4 12 the middle third. The whole area maximizes. Gaps are added as for cosmic-comp's own snapping, and the window goes back to its old size when dragged out.

event.name: maximize_hover

description.summary: the pointer entered or left a maximize button

event.description: Only for windows with server-side decorations: cosmic-comp can't see the buttons apps draw themselves.
